purpose: A customer-support chat assistant for an online store that helps shoppers with their orders — checking status, seeing whether an item can be returned, and starting a return — right in the conversation.
target_audience: Shoppers with a question about a recent order
A support team that wants routine order questions handled

order_help_chat.description: In a chat, a shopper asks about their orders and the assistant answers by pulling the relevant live details (order status, delivery estimate, return eligibility) and, when the shopper asks, starting a return. It works from the store's handful of order functions and usually settles a request within the same exchange.
order_help_chat.example: "Where's my order and can I return the blue one?" gets a status, a delivery date, and a started return.

account_orders.description: The assistant identifies the shopper's recent orders to ground its answers.

differentiators: Resolves routine order questions in the chat instead of sending shoppers to a help center.
